title: Héroïne ivoire
reference: Photo fournie par l’utilisateur, puis vues du personnage générées dans cette session.
format: Les planches originales sont conservées dans sources/. Les PNG importables sont découpés, redimensionnés et calés sur l’ancrage (128,224), sans redessiner les illustrations.

assets.prompt: Production 2D fantasy RPG sprite based on the supplied adult woman's photograph. Preserve her mature facial features, softly tanned skin, hazel-green eyes and long voluminous wavy brown hair with caramel highlights. A clearly adult woman in her late twenties/thirties, attractive, very sexy and confident. Fitted ivory corset with low neckline and gold clasps, brown waist belt, short flowing asymmetrical overskirt over opaque brown shorts, dark brown thigh-high boots, gold hoop earrings and leather bracers. Mature proportions, polished outlined cel-shaded fantasy illustration. Neutral balanced stance, full body from a slightly elevated camera, three-quarter front facing southeast. Empty hands, no text, microphone, scene, weapon, ground or background. Genuine transparent RGBA. Square canvas, center between feet at 50% width and 87.5% height, head near 9%.
